strategies.name: Soybean → Corn → Winter wheat + red clover cover

explanation.why: A third crop breaks pest and disease cycles and adds a legume or small grain that feeds the soil.
benefits: Spreads work and risk across the year
Clover adds nitrogen for the next crop
gaps: Local prices and buyers for the added crop
